name: @niivue/zarrita
description: zarrita.js-compatible Zarr reader with Rust/WebAssembly codecs (drop-in for zarrita)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/wasm/assets.js src/wasm/assets.d.ts src/wasm/core.js src/wasm/core.d.ts src/wasm/copy.js src/wasm/copy.d.ts src/wasm/zarrita.wasm dist/wasm/ && bunx esbuild src/wasm/worker.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=dist/wasm/worker.js --log-level=warning && node scripts/build-inline.mjs
scripts.build:wasm: cd rust && RUSTFLAGS="-C target-feature=+simd128,+bulk-memory" CFLAGS_wasm32_unknown_unknown="-msimd128 -mbulk-memory -O3" cargo build -p zarrita-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile wasm && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/wasm/zarrita_wasm.wasm ../src/wasm/zarrita.wasm
